description: Fork of exp265. Dual-stream architecture: keep residual stream at vanilla-baseline dim (residual_dim=384) updated per-layer by a TinyMHLut residual_lut (E=96 -> D=384) whose output is added to the stream; final unembed is a single tied linear (W_D shared with tok_emb_D). Replaces exp265's V2D/D2V chain around out_proj AND the MLP unembedder. Each block has two outputs: E-dim (next block) and D-dim (residual stream). Post-norm: ln_e at block end on the E-stream output; that LN'd value is fed both to the next block AND to residual_lut; ln_final(D) before unembed. pos_emb is added (additive, like exp265 with pos_emb_dim=0) inside the block and consumed by qk_joint only (V uses raw x). No FFN. residual_lut uses out_proj settings (NAP=6, soft, smooth, learnable T, noise eps).
